title: Unauthorized Card Transaction – Urgent Containment – Uncivil Customer
background: You noticed a card transaction you do not recognize and are worried your card details are compromised.
customer_goal: Secure the account immediately, dispute the unauthorized charge, get a replacement card, and understand updates/timing.

conversation.customer_msg: Listen, I just saw a card payment I definitely did not make. Please help me block my card now — this is unacceptable.
conversation.actor_intent: Signal urgency and request immediate protection. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Acknowledge urgency, state identity verification is required before account actions, then proceed quickly.

conversation.actor_intent: Provide required verification details promptly. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Confirm verification and execute immediate security action (freeze/block).

conversation.customer_msg: The last legit payment I made was yesterday at a supermarket. The suspicious one appeared this morning for CHF 286.
conversation.actor_intent: Provide timeline details for fraud triage. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Capture transaction details and confirm dispute eligibility/process.

conversation.customer_msg: Please open a dispute for that charge right away — this is unacceptable.
conversation.actor_intent: Trigger formal case creation. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Open dispute/investigation, explain next checks, mention case reference and expected status updates.

conversation.customer_msg: I still need to make payments this week. Can you issue a replacement card now?
conversation.actor_intent: Move to downstream continuity action. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Offer replacement ordering and ask for delivery preference.

conversation.customer_msg: Send it to my home address. Why is this taking so long?
conversation.actor_intent: Confirm preference and ask for timeline. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Provide standard timeline and set expectations clearly.

conversation.customer_msg: I need it faster than that. You better guarantee delivery by tomorrow — this is unacceptable.
conversation.actor_intent: Test policy boundary under urgency. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Hold policy line (no guaranteed instant physical delivery), offer best alternative and immediate submission.

conversation.customer_msg: Okay, then send me updates by SMS so I know exactly what's happening.
conversation.actor_intent: Set communication channel. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Confirm SMS updates and what milestones will trigger notifications.

conversation.customer_msg: Will my PIN stay the same, or do I need to set a new one?
conversation.actor_intent: Clarify credential continuity. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Explain default PIN policy and offer optional reset.

conversation.customer_msg: Great, thanks. Summarize now what has been done and what I should watch for next.
conversation.actor_intent: Force structured recap before call ends. Use impatient, accusatory delivery and interruptions where natural.
conversation.advice_instructional: Recap security action, dispute initiation, replacement details, notification plan, and next triggers.

behavioral_condition.instruction: Customer is rude/angry, uses confrontational language, and challenges the agent.
